scoring_justification: Transition temperatures are derived from the submitted c/a and potential energy curves; lattice constants are compared to paper values (T0 with tolerance). Overall a recompute-based verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected lattice constants and transition temperatures from paper Table I and Table II
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I and Table II
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the paper's reported values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own reported results, used as reference for scoring reproduction accuracy.

outputs.description: Simulated lattice constants at 300 K for fcc, hex1, hex2 phases. Missing values for c and c/a for fcc should be empty. The checker compares against hidden reference lattice constants within tolerances.
Temperature dependence of the lattice ratio c/a for hexagonal phases. The checker re-derives transition temperatures from these curves and compares them to hidden reference transition temperatures.
Potential energy per molecule versus temperature for each phase. The checker re-derives transition temperatures (orientational/structural) from these curves and compares to hidden reference values.

output_contract.notes: The hex1 phase may not appear in every simulation; scoring focuses on fcc and hex2. The agent is expected to acquire sufficient computational resources (e.g., remote HPC or GPU-accelerated MD) for the production MD runs.

steps.description: Check lattice constants against paper Table I with tolerances: a ±0.15 Å, c ±0.2 Å, c/a ±0.03. Hex1 optional.
Re-derive transition temperatures from c/a vs T curves and compare to paper Table II: hex2 onset 500 K, sat 350 K; hex1 onset 400 K, sat 100 K. Tolerance ±40 K. Check plateau values.
Detect fcc transition breakpoint near 200 K (±40 K) from potential energy curve; verify slope signatures for hex2 and hex1.
